recent_en: CUCKOO International reported on 16 Nov 2026 its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep, with net profit surging 97.1% year-on-year to RM26.6 million despite revenue declining to RM242.1 million. Earlier on 1 Oct, the company announced partnerships with four independent sales partners to expand its sales network.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results on 16 Nov 2026, with net profit surging 97.1% year-on-year to RM26.6 million.
Announced on 1 Oct 2026 partnerships with four independent sales partners to expand its sales network.
earnings_en: For 2Q26 (ended 30 Jun), revenue was RM245.9 million, up 7.9% QoQ but down 19.8% YoY; net profit was RM28.2 million, up 12.7% QoQ and 3.2% YoY; net margin was 11.5%, higher than 11.0% in the previous quarter.
